The chapters below are the **main course material**. They explain the intuition,
derive the Bayesian results, and work through economic and financial applications
with figures and Python code. Follow the [weekly plan](../course-information.qmd#weekly-plan).

Each chapter links to its **exercise session** and, where available, its
**presentation slides**. The slides support classroom presentations; use the
chapter text for the full explanation and its reading guide for further study.
